ai.tagline: I adapt AI to real tasks for people and businesses
intro: I help turn what artificial intelligence can do into clear working processes: from handling documents and preparing materials to automating routine tasks with AI agents.

I have used AI in practice since late 2022, when ChatGPT became publicly available. Since then I have applied different models and tools while building my own products, working with information, and automating everyday tasks.

My work is not limited to getting an answer from a model. I organize the whole process: understand the task, choose the tools, prepare the instructions, connect the stages, and check the quality of the result.

skills.title: Match AI to a specific task
skills.main: I clarify the result, who will use it, and which mistakes are unacceptable.
extra: I choose models and tools for the kind of work and compare them on the real task: answer quality, cost, speed, limits, and confidentiality.
I decide where one request is enough, where a chain of steps is needed, and where a person must take part.

skills.title: Write effective requests and instructions
skills.main: I turn a vague wish into a concrete task for the AI, my prompts are unambiguously understandable and the result always meets expectations.
extra: I set the context, source material, limits, answer format, and the criteria for done.
I split hard work into stages so the model is not asked to do everything at once.
Repeating work gets a template, and if a mistake keeps appearing, I fix the instruction.

skills.title: Organize the work of AI agents
skills.main: I design a process in which assistants take different roles: gather information, analyze it, produce a result, and check it.
extra: I set the order of steps, what passes between them, and a person’s approval for an important action.
I plan for missing data, errors, and contradictory results.
A one-off trial becomes a process that can be repeated.

skills.title: Check the quality of results
skills.main: I check that the result matches the original task, not only that the text sounds convincing.
extra: Confirmed information stays separate from assumptions, and important points are checked against the sources.
A separate review decides what can be used at once and what needs a manual check.

skills.title: Make AI understandable to the people who use it
skills.main: I explain what AI can and cannot do without heavy technical language.
extra: I prepare instructions, templates, and examples for everyday work.
I fit the tool into work people already do, rather than adding an extra burden.

practice: AI work since late 2022. I use different models and AI tools for development, information analysis, and automating routine tasks. I have practice in refining requests step by step, comparing model results, writing detailed instructions, and organizing multi-step work with agents.

I build my own products, combining programming, interface design, content preparation, and AI-assisted working processes. A technical background lets me do more than propose a scenario: I can connect it to a working application or an existing system.

steps: I take the task apart: what is done by hand now, what result is needed, and what the limits are.
I choose the approach: one tool, several models, or a chain of agents.
I prepare the instructions: context, rules, examples, the shape of the result, and the quality criteria.
I assemble a trial process and test it on typical and difficult cases.
I set the controls: data checks, error handling, and approval for important actions.
I revise the process from what the trials showed.
I hand over clear instructions for use and for later upkeep.
ai.example: For example, incoming documents can be handled like this: one agent extracts the information, a second puts it into the required format, a third checks completeness and contradictions, and a person confirms the result before it is used further.
ai.valueLead: I can take the path from “we want to use AI” to a working process:
value: Find the tasks where AI is actually useful.
Choose a suitable set of tools.
Set up the requests, instructions, and how the agents work together.
Connect AI to existing services and data.
Organize quality checks and human control.
Prepare the process for regular use.
ai.close: My strength is the combination of several years of practical AI work, technical skill, and attention to the final result. I can use the models, and I can build a clear system of work around them.
